notes.title: Planes, Bullets and Vodka - Major Update (new languages, polish, achievements)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27140201/bd584d047a4846cedaaa978d642417f5e7629650.gif[/img]

Hello friends, happy new year I hope you all had great holidays! I'm very excited for 2024, and plan to have a very productive year!

And here is my first delivery, I just updated Planes Bullets and Vodka, to add support to new languages, a few graphical and gameplay tweaks, and more, I'll detail it all below:

[h2]New Languages Support[/h2]
The main goal of this update is to make the game more accessible to people all around the world, heres the languages added to this update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27140201/9606ce00fda600d709f1b2e06890158c9068ce6b.gif[/img]
[list][*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Korean
[*] Italian
[*] French
[*] Portuguese-PT
[*] Czech
[*] Polish
[*] Turkish
[*] Ukranian
[*] Thai
[*] Persian
[*] Hungarian
[*] Dutch [/list]

The list was decided based on the most commom languages used on Steam. 

[h2]Gameplay and graphics update[/h2]
[list][*] Menus remade, to improve navigation.
[*] A few sprite tweaks, to have better visibility
[*] A more clear display of the background colors.[/list]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list][*] Changed the "Destroyer" achievement from 500 to 300 enemies destroyed in a single run.
[*] Changed the "That's a lot of points!" achievement from 250k to 150k points in a single run.
[*] Changed the "I love the smell of vodka in the morning" from 10k to 3k enemies destroyed in total.[/list]

As aways thank you for your continued support, and if possible I would like to ask you to check it out Burning Skies, wich is a culmination of all this years doing arcade games, (it will be an arcade/roguelike shmup), and if you like it, please wishlist the game. 
This is the most important thing to show Steam that people are interested in the game and made it visible to more player. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies/

notes.title: Shapeshooter!
notes.notes:
Hello folks, it's been a while since the last update and I have BIG NEWS!

I decided to change the name of our next game to Shapeshooter, visuals and mechanics also had a big change in direction! 

The reason to change are to make it possible to have a more diverse gameplay experience, and the name changed to be simpler and because of the changes, the game was too distant to Polygoneer to be considered a sequel.

[b]The game will come out in Q3 2020 and I'll share a precise date in a near futurem please follow and add to your wishlist to receive updates.[/b]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143900/Shapeshooter/

Thank you guys for all the support trough this years, it's not been easy lately but I'm back on track doing my best to deliver a cool game for your enjoyment.

notes.notes:

Hello friends, for this devlog I would like to highlight the Pseudo 3D buildings that I managed to develop for Razortron 2084, with this I'll be able to make much preetier and more diverse scenarios, you  can see on the gif above, the algorithm turns flat 2d images into pseudo 3D images. I also changed a litte bit the art direction on the game, to be more 'texturized' (what do you think about this) It can be seen better on the first screenshot on the game's page.

Some other things that I finished or are almost done
- Traffic IA
- Traffic and road generation for the arcade mode
- In-game color switch (this is usefull to come with cool color schemes)
- Joystick Support.

Now the things are moving much faster and I'll announce more features on the future weeks. 

Thank you very much for all the support, friends

I'm back with the fourth devlog, and this time the update is preety big:

notes.title: My new game 'Blackout Z' is now available on Steam.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30843688/fa0d4100bbe148f1067270e1ef2620a034211ebb.gif[/img]

[b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/729660/Blackout_Z_Slaughterhouse_Edition] Blackout Z: Slaughterhouse edition [/url][/b] is now available on Steam.

Slaughter tons of zombies and try to avoid sharp saws while the battery of your flashlight is slowly draining!

This is a highly re-playable arcade game, the objectives include Score Chase (with steam leaderboards), unlock weapons hats and achievements. Perfect to play when you don't have much time but need a boost of adrenaline or while you are on a queue for another game. 

Thanks for all the support on my small games, I trully hope you'll enjoy this new one. [b]PLEASE[/b], if you enjoyed Blackout Z make sure to leave a brief review, that helps [b]A LOT[/b] for small games and a solo indie dev like myself. 

Thank you for playing.
Paulo Brunassi

notes.title: Big update - Ver. 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello friends, it's been awhile since the last update, and 2017 its been an awesome year, 2 new games released so far here on steam, and a new one coming soon.

But apart of that, I just uploaded a new update for Planes, Bullets and Vodka and its a big one this time, here goes:

[h1]Major changes/fixes:[/h1]
[list][*]Leaderboards implemented
[*]Vodka (yes, a vodka item \o)
[*]A bigger saturation range options (image below)
[*]Changed the behavior of the power Ups 
[*]Changed the power ups spawn ratio and the power up selection algorithm
[*]Added a tutorial
[*]A new trailer for the soundtrack (get yours for free)
[*]Joystick vibration
[*]Updated the store descriptions and added german language to the store[/list]

[h1]Minor changes/fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Player weren't able to return to the title screen while paused using keyboard or joystick
[*]The menu music didn't plays
[*]The music "Forbidden Beat"didnt play ingame (the trailer music)
[*]Player weren't able to set the volumes to zero (mute)
[*]Screenshake didn't worked well while shooting

The new saturation range mentioned:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27140201/75c5b46f4e1c17e2ec4541c27e7e10a910f9abf2.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27140201/9f95b827c9701d8e75bf4e4895d11f85bc4c3e40.png[/img][/url]

If you enjoyed the game, please leave a positive feedback, it helps A LOT for a small dev like myself.

Check out my new game Polygoneer:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/

Follow me on twitter for more updates on what I'm doing:
https://twitter.com/ThisIsNuk
